classification.difficultyReason: Convert the wheel diameter to metres and multiply its circumference by three turns.

content.prompt:
A wheel on a bicycle has a diameter of 530 mm. The wheel turns 3 times.
Approximately how many metres has the bicycle travelled? Give your answer to the nearest metre.
